name: manual_d5c812
claim: A command-line parser must distinguish a missing option value from a supplied value rejected by validation, while preserving a single nonzero failure path and an actionable diagnostic.

decisions.notes: The Bash 3.2 launcher follow-up distinguishes dangling --host from blank or option-like host values at the parser boundary, then verifies the same diagnostic contract through the executable.

rationale: The Bash 3.2 launcher follow-up distinguishes dangling --host from blank or option-like host values at the parser boundary, then verifies the same diagnostic contract through the executable.
